review: 403: checked all scenarios and card scripts; no changes needed.

scenarios.title: A mass-destruction spell checks only the battlefield

setup.notes: Centaur Courser is a creature card in B's graveyard.

decisions: A casts Wrath of God, tapping four Plains.
Both players pass; Wrath of God resolves.

variants.label: on_battlefield
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is destroyed and goes to B's graveyard on top of Centaur Courser. Centaur Courser is untouched in the graveyard.

variants.label: in_hand
variants.delta: Grizzly Bears is a card in B's hand instead of on the battlefield.
variants.expected: Wrath of God destroys nothing; Grizzly Bears stays in B's hand and Centaur Courser stays in the graveyard.

scenarios.title: A creature card outside the battlefield is not a legal target for a spell that targets creatures

setup.notes: No creature is on the battlefield.

decisions: A considers casting Giant Growth with Forest untapped.

variants.label: card_in_graveyard
variants.expected: Giant Growth has no legal target, since Grizzly Bears in the graveyard is not on the battlefield, and A cannot cast it.

variants.label: creature_on_battlefield
variants.delta: Grizzly Bears is on A's battlefield instead of in the graveyard.
variants.expected: Giant Growth has a legal target, Grizzly Bears, and A can cast it.

scenarios.title: A permanent that re-enters the battlefield is a new object

setup.notes: Grizzly Bears is a 3/3 with one +1/+1 counter and 1 damage marked. B holds Counterspell with two untapped Islands and passes unless a variant says otherwise.

decisions: A casts Cloudshift targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Plains.
B passes; both players pass; Cloudshift resolves.

variants.label: blink
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is exiled and returns as a new 2/2 with no counters, no damage and summoning sickness.

variants.label: countered
variants.delta: B responds with Counterspell, tapping both Islands, and it counters Cloudshift.
variants.expected: Cloudshift is countered; Grizzly Bears never leaves the battlefield and keeps its +1/+1 counter and 1 damage as a 3/3.

variants.label: etb_creature
variants.delta: The creature is Elvish Visionary (1/1) with a +1/+1 counter and 1 damage instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Elvish Visionary returns as a new 1/1 with no counter or damage and its enters trigger fires, so A draws Forest.
